description:
Hand back a matched pair of shares and take the sBTC out: burns `sats` BONDED and `sats` IDLE, returns `sats` sBTC.

This is the exit at par, and the reason the two sides' prices sum to one. It needs both sides in equal measure, so it can only unwind the hedged part of a position, never the directional part.

Only works while the market is open — after resolve, use atstake_redeem. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

sats.description: Matched pairs to merge back into sBTC.
